movers-get-dressed.hint: You do this every morning before school.
movers-get-dressed.fact: Buttons and zips help you get dressed.

movers-get-off.definition: to leave a bus, train, or bike.
movers-get-off.definitionVi: Xuống xe buýt, tàu hoặc xe đạp.
movers-get-off.hint: Wait until the vehicle stops first.
movers-get-off.fact: Always look both ways after you get off.

movers-get-on.definition: to board a bus, train, or bike.
movers-get-on.definitionVi: Lên xe buýt, tàu hoặc xe đạp.
movers-get-on.hint: Hold the handrail when you step up.
movers-get-on.fact: People queue politely to get on a bus.

movers-get-undressed.hint: You do this before a bath or bed.
movers-get-undressed.fact: Put dirty clothes in the laundry basket.

movers-get-up.definition: to leave your bed in the morning.
movers-get-up.definitionVi: Thức dậy và ra khỏi giường.
movers-get-up.hint: Your alarm clock helps you get up.
movers-get-up.fact: Stretching when you get up feels good.

movers-glass.definition: A cup made of clear hard material.
movers-glass.hint: You drink water or juice from it.
movers-glass.fact: Glass can break, so hold it carefully.

movers-go-shopping.definition: to visit shops to buy things.
movers-go-shopping.definitionVi: Đi mua sắm ở cửa hàng.
movers-go-shopping.hint: Mum might take you to the supermarket.
movers-go-shopping.fact: Making a list helps when you go shopping.

movers-goal.definition: The place where you score in football.
movers-goal.hint: Kick the ball into the net to score.
movers-goal.fact: Cheering erupts when a team scores a goal.

movers-granddaughter.definitionVi: Cháu gái — con gái của con bạn.
movers-granddaughter.fact: A granddaughter is part of your family tree.

movers-grandparent.definitionVi: Ông bà — bố hoặc mẹ của bố mẹ bạn.
movers-grandparent.fact: Grandparents often tell the best stories.

movers-grandson.definitionVi: Cháu trai — con trai của con bạn.
movers-grandson.fact: A grandson is part of your family tree.

movers-grass.definition: Green plants that cover the ground.
movers-grass.definitionVi: Cỏ xanh mọc trên mặt đất.
movers-grass.hint: You can sit on it in the park.
movers-grass.fact: Grass feels soft under bare feet.

movers-ground.definition: The solid surface under your feet.
movers-ground.hint: Leaves fall on the ground in autumn.
movers-ground.fact: Worms live in the ground underground.

movers-grow.definitionVi: Lớn lên hoặc mọc lên theo thời gian.
movers-grow.fact: Sunlight and water help plants grow.

movers-grown-up.definition: An adult person, not a child.
movers-grown-up.definitionVi: Người lớn, không phải trẻ em.
movers-grown-up.fact: Grown-ups can drive cars and vote.

movers-have-got-to.definition: to need or must do something.
movers-have-got-to.hint: You have got to wear a seat belt in the car.
movers-have-got-to.fact: Rules help us know what we have got to do.

movers-headache.hint: Rest and water can help a headache.
movers-headache.fact: Too much screen time can cause headaches.

movers-helmet.definition: Hard head protection for cycling or sport.
movers-helmet.definitionVi: Mũ bảo hiểm bảo vệ đầu.
movers-helmet.hint: Wear one when you ride a bike.
movers-helmet.fact: Helmets protect your head if you fall.

movers-help.hint: Friends help each other with homework.
movers-help.fact: Helping others makes everyone feel good.

movers-hide.definition: to go where others cannot see you.
movers-hide.definitionVi: Trốn, ẩn nấp để không ai thấy.
movers-hide.hint: You hide behind a tree in hide-and-seek.
movers-hide.fact: Animals hide to stay safe from danger.

movers-holiday.definition: A special day off from school or work.
movers-holiday.definitionVi: Ngày nghỉ lễ hoặc kỳ nghỉ.
movers-holiday.hint: Christmas and summer break are holidays.
movers-holiday.fact: Many families travel on holiday together.

movers-homework.definition: School work you do at home.
movers-homework.fact: Doing homework helps you remember lessons.

movers-hop.definitionVi: Nhảy lò cò trên một chân.
movers-hop.fact: Hopscotch is a game where you hop on squares.

movers-hospital.definition: A place where sick people get care.
movers-hospital.fact: Ambulances take people to hospital quickly.

movers-hot.definition: Having a high temperature; very warm.
movers-hot.hint: Ice cream melts on a hot day.
movers-hot.fact: Drink water when the weather is hot.

movers-how.definitionVi: Như thế nào, bằng cách nào.
movers-how.fact: How is one of the five W question words.

movers-how-much.definitionVi: Bao nhiêu tiền hoặc bao nhiêu lượng.
movers-how-much.hint: Say it when you buy something at a shop.
movers-how-much.fact: How much costs less than how many for liquids.

movers-how-often.definition: Asking how many times something happens.
movers-how-often.definitionVi: Bao lâu một lần, thường xuyên ra sao.
movers-how-often.hint: How often do you brush your teeth?
movers-how-often.fact: Dentists ask how often you floss.

movers-huge.hint: A whale is a huge animal.
movers-huge.fact: Huge ships carry goods across oceans.

movers-hundred.fact: One hundred years is called a century.

movers-hungry.hint: Your tummy rumbles when you are hungry.
movers-hungry.fact: Breakfast helps when you wake up hungry.

movers-hurt.definition: to feel pain or cause pain.
movers-hurt.definitionVi: Bị đau hoặc làm ai đó đau.
movers-hurt.hint: You might hurt your knee if you fall.
movers-hurt.fact: A plaster can help a small hurt feel better.

movers-ice.definition: Frozen water that is hard and cold.
movers-ice.hint: It melts in your drink on a hot day.
movers-ice.fact: Ice skaters glide on smooth ice.

movers-ice-skates.definition: Boots with blades for skating on ice.
movers-ice-skates.definitionVi: Giày trượt băng có lưỡi dao.
movers-ice-skates.hint: You wear them at an ice rink.
movers-ice-skates.fact: Ice skates let you glide across frozen ponds.

movers-ice-skating.hint: People spin and glide at the rink.
movers-ice-skating.fact: Ice skating is popular in cold countries.

movers-idea.definition: A thought or plan in your mind.
movers-idea.definitionVi: Ý tưởng, suy nghĩ trong đầu.
movers-idea.hint: Say "Good idea!" when you like a plan.
movers-idea.fact: Sharing ideas helps teams solve problems.

movers-ill.hint: You stay home from school when ill.
movers-ill.fact: Rest and soup help when you feel ill.

movers-inside.definition: In the inner part; not outside.
movers-inside.definitionVi: Ở bên trong, không phải ngoài trời.
movers-inside.fact: It is warm inside on a rainy day.

movers-internet.definition: A global network of connected computers.
movers-internet.definitionVi: Mạng internet kết nối máy tính.
movers-internet.hint: You use it to watch videos and learn.
movers-internet.fact: The internet links people around the world.

movers-invite.definition: to ask someone to come to an event.
movers-invite.definitionVi: Mời ai đó đến dự sự kiện.
movers-invite.hint: You invite friends to your birthday party.
movers-invite.fact: Party invitations can be cards or messages.

movers-island.definition: Land with water all around it.
movers-island.definitionVi: Hòn đảo — đất bao quanh bởi nước.
movers-island.hint: Hawaii and Bali are famous islands.
movers-island.fact: Some islands have volcanoes and beaches.

movers-jungle.definition: A thick, hot forest with many plants.
movers-jungle.hint: Monkeys and parrots live in jungles.
movers-jungle.fact: Jungles are home to colourful birds and insects.

movers-kangaroo.definitionVi: Chuột túi — loài nhảy ở Úc.
movers-kangaroo.hint: It carries a baby in its pouch.
movers-kangaroo.fact: Kangaroos can jump over three metres high.

movers-kind.definition: A type or sort of something.
movers-kind.definitionVi: Loại, kiểu của một thứ gì.
movers-kind.hint: What kind of ice cream do you like?
movers-kind.fact: There are many kinds of dogs and cats.

movers-kitten.hint: It says "meow" and loves to play.
movers-kitten.fact: Kittens learn to hunt by playing with toys.

movers-lake.definition: A large body of water surrounded by land.
movers-lake.definitionVi: Hồ nước lớn giữa đất liền.
movers-lake.fact: Some lakes are so big they look like seas.

movers-laptop.definition: A small computer you can carry.
movers-laptop.hint: You can use it on your desk or lap.
movers-laptop.fact: Laptops run on batteries when unplugged.

movers-last.definition: Coming at the end; most recent.
movers-last.hint: Last week means the week before this one.
movers-last.fact: The last day of school feels exciting.

movers-laugh.definition: The sound when something is funny.
movers-laugh.hint: Jokes and silly faces make you laugh.

movers-leaf.definition: The flat green part on a plant stem.
movers-leaf.hint: Leaves turn red and gold in autumn.
movers-leaf.fact: Trees lose their leaves in cold winters.

movers-library.definition: A quiet place full of books to borrow.
movers-library.hint: You can read stories here for free.
movers-library.fact: Libraries have thousands of books to explore.

movers-lift.definition: A small room that moves up and down.
movers-lift.hint: Press a button to choose your floor.
movers-lift.fact: Lifts are also called elevators in America.

movers-lion.definition: A big wild cat with a mane.
movers-lion.definitionVi: Sư tử — mèo lớn có bờm.
movers-lion.hint: It roars loudly in the savanna.
movers-lion.fact: Lions live in groups called prides.

movers-little.hint: A mouse is a little animal.
movers-little.fact: Little steps still take you forward.

movers-look-for.hint: You look for your keys before school.
movers-look-for.fact: Detectives look for clues to solve mysteries.

movers-lose.hint: You lose a game when the other team scores more.
movers-lose.fact: Putting things in the same place stops you losing them.

movers-loud.hint: A drum is a loud instrument.
movers-loud.fact: Cover your ears if music is too loud.

movers-loudly.definition: In a way that makes much noise.
movers-loudly.hint: Do not speak loudly in the library.

movers-machine.definition: A device that does work with moving parts.
movers-machine.definitionVi: Máy móc có bộ phận chuyển động.
movers-machine.fact: Simple machines include levers and wheels.

movers-map.definition: A drawing that shows places and roads.
movers-map.definitionVi: Bản đồ chỉ đường và địa điểm.
movers-map.hint: Use one to find your way on a trip.
movers-map.fact: Treasure maps have X marks the spot.

movers-market.definition: An outdoor place where people sell food.
movers-market.definitionVi: Chợ ngoài trời bán thực phẩm.
movers-market.hint: Stalls sell fruit, fish, and bread.
movers-market.fact: Markets are busy and colourful on weekends.

movers-matter.hint: Ask "What's the matter?" when someone is sad.
movers-matter.fact: Talking about a matter can make you feel better.

movers-mean.hint: Red means stop on traffic lights.
movers-mean.fact: A smile can mean you are happy.

movers-message.definition: Words you send to someone by phone.
movers-message.definitionVi: Tin nhắn gửi qua điện thoại.
movers-message.hint: You type it and press send.
movers-message.fact: Messages can travel around the world in seconds.

movers-milkshake.definition: A cold sweet drink made with milk.
movers-milkshake.hint: It comes in chocolate or strawberry flavour.
movers-milkshake.fact: Milkshakes are popular at cafés and diners.

movers-mistake.hint: Cross it out and try again.

movers-model.definition: A small copy of something real.
movers-model.definitionVi: Mô hình thu nhỏ của vật thật.
movers-model.hint: You might build a model aeroplane.
movers-model.fact: Model trains run on tiny tracks.

movers-moon.definition: The round object that shines at night.
movers-moon.hint: It changes shape during the month.
movers-moon.fact: Astronauts walked on the moon in 1969.

movers-more.hint: Can I have more juice, please?
movers-more.fact: Practice more and you improve faster.

movers-most.fact: Most of Earth is covered by water.

movers-mountain.definition: A very high hill with a peak.
movers-mountain.hint: Snow sits on top of tall mountains.
movers-mountain.fact: Mount Everest is the highest mountain on Earth.

movers-moustache.definition: Hair grown above a man's upper lip.
movers-moustache.hint: Some men shave it every morning.
movers-moustache.fact: Moustaches come in many shapes and sizes.

movers-move.definition: to change position or go somewhere.
movers-move.hint: Plants move slowly toward the sun.
movers-move.fact: Dance is a fun way to move your body.

movers-movie.definition: A story shown on a screen.
movers-movie.hint: You watch it at the cinema.
movers-movie.fact: Popcorn is a popular movie snack.

movers-must.definition: to have to do something; necessary.
movers-must.hint: You must wear a uniform at some schools.
movers-must.fact: Must shows a strong rule or need.
